title: Outgrown-Plan Credit on Harborline Cloud 8 Upgrades
content:
**Web Hosting Plans pricing note — outgrown-plan credit**

The Cloud 8 upgrade charge is reduced by an outgrown-plan credit when the plan has received resource notices dated less than one calendar month before today: USD 40.00 when at least one of them is an over-limit notice, USD 20.00 when there are warning notices and no over-limit notice, and no credit when there are none.

Resource notices are the plan's usage notices for inodes, storage or CPU, each recorded at the warning level or the over-limit level.

| Resource notices on the plan dated less than one calendar month before today | Outgrown-plan credit |
|---|---|
| at least one over-limit notice (with or without warnings) | USD 40.00 |
| one or more warning notices, no over-limit notice | USD 20.00 |
| no notice | none |

**Cases (hypothetical, today 18 September).**

- A storage warning on 2 September and a CPU over-limit notice on 9 September: USD 40.00.
- Two inode warnings in early September and no over-limit notice: USD 20.00.
- No notice since 18 August: no credit.
